mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kyc_gap_profile ( profile_id, customer_id, as_of, known_items, partial_known_items, stale_items, conflicting_or_ambiguous_items, unknown_items, priority_questions, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{profileId}, #{customerId}, #{asOf}, #{knownItems, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{partialKnownItems, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{staleItems, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{conflictingOrAmbiguousItems, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{unknownItems, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{priorityQuestions, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{createdAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, #{updatedAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler} )
mapper.select: SELECT profile_id, customer_id, as_of, known_items, partial_known_items, stale_items, conflicting_or_ambiguous_items, unknown_items, priority_questions, created_at, updated_at FROM kyc_gap_profile WHERE profile_id = #{profileId}

SELECT profile_id, customer_id, as_of, known_items, partial_known_items, stale_items, conflicting_or_ambiguous_items, unknown_items, priority_questions, created_at, updated_at FROM kyc_gap_profile WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY as_of DESC
